_comment: Orinoco AI Assistant Egg for Pterodactyl Panel 1.x. Import into a dedicated Nest. Preview only: do not deploy until the matching Orinoco image is published and live-tested.
name: Orinoco AI Assistant
author: Orinoco AI Project
description: Preview Egg for Orinoco, a self-hosted personal AI assistant with a custom interface, local Ollama chat, account security and private conversation storage.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/models
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/documents
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/backups
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/logs

cat > /mnt/server/.orinoco-install-state <<'EOF'
Orinoco Pterodactyl server directory initialised.
Application code and runtime dependencies are supplied by the Docker image.
EOF

echo 'Orinoco server directories prepared.'

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: Select the local Ollama model. Qwen 2.5 1.5B is the recommended starting point; 3B is experimental on the planned VPS.

variables.name: Automatically Download Model
variables.description: Download the selected Ollama model into persistent server storage on first start.

variables.name: Model Context
variables.description: Context length in tokens used by local model requests.

variables.name: Automatically Save Memories
variables.description: Allow Orinoco to extract a small number of durable, non-sensitive personal memories after a chat. Users can review, edit and delete their own memories.

variables.name: AI Concurrency
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous model generations. The initial runtime supports one.

variables.name: Enable Discord
variables.description: Discord integration is planned and is not active yet.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Reserved for future Discord integration. Keep blank; do not add a real token until secret handling is finalised.

variables.name: Enable Voice
variables.description: Voice features are planned and are not active yet. Listening will require explicit activation.

variables.name: Enable Web Search
variables.description: Web research is planned and is not active yet.

variables.name: SearXNG URL
variables.description: Optional future SearXNG endpoint. Leave blank until search integration is available.

variables.name: Database Path
variables.description: Persistent SQLite database location. Leave the default unless you know why it needs changing.

variables.name: Backup Encryption Key
variables.description: Required for encrypted backup creation, verification and restore. Generate with python -m orinoco.backups generate-key and store the key securely outside the VPS. Do not reuse it elsewhere.

variables.name: S3 Backup Endpoint
variables.description: HTTPS endpoint for a private S3-compatible object-storage service. Leave blank until remote backup storage is configured.

variables.name: S3 Backup Bucket
variables.description: Private bucket name for encrypted Orinoco backup files.

variables.name: S3 Backup Access Key ID
variables.description: Restricted object-storage access key. Grant access only to the dedicated backup bucket.

variables.name: S3 Backup Secret Access Key
variables.description: Secret for the restricted object-storage access key. Keep this hidden from normal users.

variables.name: S3 Backup Region
variables.description: Object-storage region or provider region identifier.

variables.name: S3 Backup Prefix
variables.description: Folder-like object key prefix used for Orinoco backups.
